description: The main window renders the studio from a remote localhost origin (studio_url). Remote pages get no IPC by default in Tauri v2, so this capability grants that origin core IPC access — enough for shell actions invoked from the studio UI (e.g. the settings 'Pair a device' button calling open_pairing_window). Scoped to the main window and localhost origins only; no shell/sidecar or updater permissions are exposed to the remote page.
